case.summary: The investigation found four online purchases of about $470 each on card C02265-K1 within 30 minutes, totaling $1,904.86, which matches a known fraud pattern of structuring just below a $500 authorization limit. The case was escalated to a fraud analyst who confirmed the pattern appears on 11 other cards, indicating a coordinated scheme. The card was blocked, pending authorizations were declined, connected cards were monitored, a report was filed, and the case was escalated to an analyst for further review.

sar.reason: File: fraud strongly suspected and exposure $1,904.86 exceeds $1,000; the activity connects to a shared device profile / other customers' cards; the pattern is coordinated and undocumented (R9) (section 3a, R2/R6/R9).
sar.narrative: Between 2016-12-02 19:00 and 2016-12-02 19:30, card C02265-K1 held by customer C02265 was used for 4 online transaction(s) totalling $1,904.86 (transaction IDs 3507563, 3507591, 3507626, 3507670). The activity came to the bank's attention through an analyst request on 2016-12-02 19:30:00, referring to transaction 3507670 for $469.47. The transactions were billed in region code(s) 308 (country code 87 unless noted), and the purchaser email domain was msn.com. Online activity used the device profile Windows | Windows 10 | chrome 64.0 | 1920x1080. The activity fits none of the bank's five documented fraud patterns. Authorization-threshold structuring: 4 online purchases on one card, each between $400 and $500, inside about 30 minutes, from more than one device. The amounts look chosen to stay just under a $500 authorization limit. The same run shape appears on 11 other cards in the surrounding weeks, so it is a repeated scheme across customers rather than one compromised card. The same scheme links to other cards, which have been placed under monitoring: C00466-K1, C01890-K1, C03633-K1, C05423-K1, C05766-K1, C05851-K1, C06881-K1, C07297-K1, C10751-K1, C10990-K1, C12641-K2. Analyst confirms the repeated under-$500 run shape links 11 other cards with the same activity in the window and agrees it is one coordinated scheme. The card has been recommended for blocking and reissue, and the total suspicious amount reported is $1,904.86.

stop_reason: The shared element and the linked cards are identified and the analyst confirmed the scheme; further steps would not change the actions.
